description: This file contains JavaScript functions for a web-based test automation interface in TestLink, including functions for opening import result windows, starting test case execution via AJAX, creating XMLHttpRequest objects, and handling AJAX response states.

methods.name: openImportResult(windows_title,tproject_id,tplan_id,build_id,platform_id)
methods.description: Opens a popup window to facilitate XML import for test results, passing relevant IDs as URL parameters.

methods.name: startExecution(node_id,node_type)
methods.description: Initiates the execution of a test case via AJAX call to tcexecute.php, updating the page with the response.

methods.name: GetXmlHttpObject()
methods.description: Creates and returns an XMLHttpRequest object, with compatibility for different browsers.

methods.name: stateChanged()
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request state changes, updating the DOM elements with execution status and results.
